hypothesis: 20 referenced normative stroke sources (金8,尊12) with no extra strokes may permit original terminal-curve styling without changing readable Chinese.
word_use: Research/test label only; no inference that the user approved this as final brand name or an official design.

reference_data_source.limitations: Hanzi Writer medians derive from typefaces and are a pedagogical structural reference, not sufficient proof of normative current stroke appearance or a professional designer's original contours.

method.A: all 20 canonical median source strokes rendered as continuous closed filled vector contours, near-uniform brush weight
method.B: same 20 source stroke IDs and character positions, changed pressure/taper and very limited endpoint-preserving trajectory bends in 金 stroke2 and 尊 stroke10; no decorative add-on contour
method.reference_font: Noto Sans CJK only in a separate reading baseline, not copied as authored paths

real_QA.error: left/right normal offset self-intersected around bent strokes; this was an actual engineering INVALID result, preserved as build_trial.py and FAIL_FIRST_RENDER.json
real_QA.repair: changed polygonization algorithm only (connected variable-width disk union); no second aesthetic candidate, same frozen art direction and 20 sources
real_QA.native_format: RGBA transparent PNG with native editable SVG

conclusions.stroke_source_gate: PASS: exact 8/12 indexed semantic strokes, 20 closed geometrically valid outline paths each after renderer fix
conclusions.visual_Hanzi_correctness: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED. Count-matching can still distort glyph components, exact recognition requires readers.
conclusions.assistant_visual_review: FAIL: B barely differs from A as an intentional wordmark; both have weaker glyph weight balance than neutral type benchmark at large and 96/64px sizes.
conclusions.causal_lesson: Even zero spurious strokes and perfect semantic source paths do not produce professional lettering. Pinned median skeleton reconstruction is not sufficient creative direction.
conclusions.next: Stop using Hanzi Writer medians as the generator of finished glyph contours. Keep them only for semantic audit. Before any further design choose one demonstrably effective author-published structural change and require readable whole-glyph human review + visible whole-word improvement compared at equal size. Otherwise do not continue serial R numbering.
